cs.t: Ebike. Bought a REI Cty 2.2 for my wife. Buying Yamaha CrossCore RC for myself next year. Unless you are extremely fit, an ebike will literally change your life. It is so pleasant to just be able to bike for 30-40 miles at 20mph. I would recommend torque sensing mid drives without a throttle because you can still get some exercise. I used to bike hard in teens. As I aged things got harder, I then had some mild nerve damage and my muscles now get tired quicker. Ebike makes me feel like I have teen legs again and it feels amazing.
